name: Dark Cloud
source:
He grew up as the son of the head of the Dark Tiger, but when he had a wife and child, he wanted to leave the organization.
He had not been able to say so for a long time, but when Wei was kidnapped, he wondered whether he should make a move or not.
In the end, Prince's trickery allowed Wei to succeed him, and he was able to become a firm member of the organization.
He is a master of Hakkyoku-ken.
He is acquainted with Seraph, but he does not know Seraph's true identity.
